name: @magpie-community/opencode-bailucode-auth
description: BAILU AI (白鹿, bailucode.com) for OpenCode and magpie: an API key or a browser sign-in that fetches one, live models, the 白鹿通行证 quota (credits, tokens, per-protocol packs) and the portal's daily check-in

summary.zh: 白鹿 Open Platform（bailucode.com/openapi）接入 magpie：可粘贴 API key，也可用浏览器登录自动取回账号里的 key；模型按 key 实时拉取，卡片显示通行证额度（积分 / Token / 定向额度），并接上门户的每日签到。
summary.en: BAILU Open Platform (bailucode.com/openapi) for magpie: paste an API key, or sign in through the browser and let it fetch the account's key; models from the key, the 白鹿通行证 quota (credits, tokens, per-protocol packs) on the card, and the portal's daily check-in.
